platform: Optimizely/Insite Configured Commerce (SPA; /api/v1 storefront API). Product pages /Product/<SKU> are client-rendered (no JSON-LD/og:image in HTML)
catalog_endpoint: https://www.intermatic.com/api/v1/products?query=<SKU>&expand=images (exact search) ; full listing https://www.intermatic.com/api/v1/products?page=N&pageSize=100..400 ; also /api/v1/catalogpages?path=/Product/<SKU>. Sitemap https://www.intermatic.com/sitemap1.xml lists 1185 /Product/<SKU> URLs.
sku_format_match: yes - erpNumber/urlSegment equal the sample SKUs (T1472BR, WP1030C, L5F13D1DG2, UWZ48E-240U); search may return extra close matches (UWZ48-240U) so match erpNumber exactly

sample_tests.note: images are family shots (filenames reference T1871BR/T1471BR)

recommended_strategy: Page through https://www.intermatic.com/api/v1/products?page=N&pageSize=400 (~5 calls) or query per SKU with ?query=<SKU>&expand=images; match product.erpNumber exactly (case-insensitive); use productImages[].largeImagePath (or largeImagePath). For higher resolution swap '/inriver/preview/' -> '/inriver/original/' (verified 200, ~4 MB PNG vs ~1.1 MB preview; '/large/' and '/full/' return 403).
